text: A song of ascents. Of David. LORD, my heart is not proud, nor are my eyes lifted high; I do not busy myself with things too great and too wondrous for me.
Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child, my soul rests within me.

versions.text: No, I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child, my soul rests within me.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew 'im-lo' here is an oath formula functioning as a strong affirmation ('surely'), not a negation. Opening with 'No,' is confusing when read aloud, since it sounds like a denial rather than an emphatic assertion.

text: Israel, put your hope in the LORD, from now on and forever.
